copilot.intro: Ask anything about this dossier. Answers are grounded in the dossier's own data; the copilot is read-only and cannot change anything.

copilot.unavailable: AI is unavailable right now (demo cap or no model access). The rest of Frank OS keeps working.
copilot.readOnlyNote: Read-only copilot: it can look things up and draft, but every action stays with you. BSN and account numbers are redacted before anything reaches the model.

payments.title: Payments

payments.approveBlocked: Blocked: resolve validation errors and machtiging reviews first.

payments.demoExportNote: Exported as {filename} — DEMO file, do not deliver to a bank. Real-bank export is disabled outside a configured production environment.
payments.machtigingDisclaimer: This flag signals that consent of the client or authorization of the kantonrechter may be required (LOVT April 2025). It is a review flag, not a legal conclusion — you decide and record the basis.
payments.openBatchExists: An open payment batch already exists — finish or cancel it first.

approveSummary.ack: I have reviewed every payment in this batch and confirm the approval.

payments.auditMicrocopy: Approval is recorded in the audit log under your name.
payments.approvedBanner: Batch approved by {name} — locked and recorded in the audit log. The OS never moves money itself.

team.intro: Who can act in Frank, and with which role. Approving payment batches, resolving legal-review flags and approving letters are reserved for the bewindvoerder role.
team.devModeNote: Demo identities are active (no Clerk keys configured). Roles and the four-eyes rule are enforced exactly as with real sign-in.
team.name: Name
team.vierOgenNote: With more than one active bewindvoerder, a payment batch must be approved by someone other than its creator (four-eyes rule). Every team change is recorded in the audit log.

error.role_required: Only a bewindvoerder can manage the team.
error.self_change: You cannot change your own role or status.
error.last_bewindvoerder: The office must keep at least one active bewindvoerder.

signals.dismissHint: Dismissing records your judgment that this needs no action. It returns only if the situation clears and later recurs. The dismissal is written to the audit log.

debtsTab.invariantNote: Balances change only through evidence: a reconciled bank payment or a creditor statement (document required). A payment export never changes a debt.

error.role_required: Only a bewindvoerder can do this.

rvPeriod.hint: As set by the rechtbank (court letter / Mijn CBM). The reporting period is recorded, never inferred.

office.benchmarkNote: The hour benchmark is this office's own capacity yardstick derived from the fee level — not a legal norm. Fees are capped by the Regeling; margin comes from hours.
office.timeCoverageNote: {count} of {total} dossiers have no time logged this year — the rate figures are only as good as the time written.
office.emptySentence: Active dossiers appear here with their fee and hours.

error.invalid_minutes: Minutes must be a whole number between 1 and 1440.
error.role_required: Only a bewindvoerder can do this.
error.not_owner: You can only remove your own entries.

office.vatNote: Amounts are the statutory amounts excluding VAT. Whether VAT applies depends on this office's own tax position — Frank does not assume it.

agents.title: Agents
agents.ceilingNote: What each agent may do is decided in code and enforced on the server — not asked of the model. An agent cannot call an action outside its grant.
agents.neverNote: No agent can apply a debt event, move money, approve anything, file with a court, or send outbound communication. Those acts are not in the agent vocabulary at all, so none can be requested.

category.interpretation: Frank's reading of a fact — revisable, never confirmed
category.draft: A draft — changes nothing until a human accepts it
category.protective: Opens a protective work item — asserts nothing, disposed of only by a human

candidacy.candidate: Accepted unchanged {pct}% of the time. On this evidence the class would be a candidate for automation — a note for a human, not something Frank acts on.
candidacy.not_yet: Accepted unchanged {pct}% of the time. Not a candidate for automation.

obligations.unrouted: Frank could not identify the dossier
obligations.provisional: Frank proposed this dossier. Confirm it before acting — nothing that depends on who this client is may proceed on an unconfirmed link.
obligations.noMoneyNote: Approving a reply does not change any balance. A debt adjustment is a separate, explicit decision.

error.role_required: Only a bewindvoerder can approve this
error.letter_not_approved: The letter could not be approved

wik.title: Collection costs exceed the statutory maximum
wik.detail: {charged} charged on a principal of {principal}. The statutory maximum is {max} — an excess of {excess}.

obligations.actionedWithLetter: Reply approved — not sent, and no money moved

safeguarding.intro: Frank checks each account for patterns it does not have an explanation for. Most of the time everything is fine. A flag is a question, never a conclusion.
safeguarding.neverFraudNote: This is an unexplained pattern, not an allegation. Only a person decides what it means.
safeguarding.officeNote: These concern this office. A case is immutable to the person it concerns, and where no independent reviewer exists it stays open rather than being quietly closed. For a solo office the standing external destination is the appointing kantonrechter.
safeguarding.concernsYou: This case concerns you, so you cannot resolve or escalate it. An independent reviewer must — for a solo office, the appointing kantonrechter.
safeguarding.emptySentence: No account shows a pattern Frank cannot account for.

title.structuring: Repeated withdrawals just under a round amount
title.rapid_in_out: Money in, then almost the same amount straight out
title.new_payee_high_value: High-value payment to an account not recorded before
title.direct_debit_without_recorded_mandate: Direct debit with no mandate on file
title.beneficiary_name_mismatch: Account name differs from the creditor on file
title.office_linked_beneficiary_outside_fee_ba: Payment to an office-linked account outside the fee basis

detail.cash_withdrawal_spike: {recent} withdrawn in the last {days} days, against a monthly baseline of {baseline} for this client.
detail.rapid_in_out: {credit} came in and {debit} went out {days} day(s) later.
detail.new_payee_high_value: {amount} to {counterparty} — this account is not recorded earlier in Frank, which is not the same as never used before.
detail.direct_debit_without_recorded_mandate: {counterparty} collected {amount}. No mandate is recorded here — which does not mean none exists.
detail.beneficiary_name_mismatch: On file: {onFile}. On the transaction: {onTransaction}. Worth verifying before paying.
detail.office_linked_beneficiary_outside_fee_ba: {amount} to {beneficiary}, outside the recorded fee basis.
detail.fee_above_schedule: {charged} charged where the schedule permits {permitted} — {excess} more.
detail.four_eyes_violation: The same person created and approved batch {batch} while more than one bewindvoerder was active.

error.role_required: Only a bewindvoerder can do this
error.no_client_question: This case has no question for the client
error.office_wide_needs_external_review: This concerns the office as a whole, so it must go to an external reviewer — you can escalate it

processes.intro: Every legal procedure this office runs, with what each one is waiting on. A process is blocked when nobody here can move it — a court, a client or a creditor has to act first.
processes.derivedNote: Step status is derived from what is actually recorded in the dossier, not stored separately. A step is done because the work is done, never because someone ticked it.
processes.emptySentence: No open dossier has a procedure under way.
